BOARD-IMPL.title: Assigned ticket in the implement stage
BOARD-IMPL.description: This ticket is actively assigned to a developer and sits in the implement column. It exists to prove that a real assignee is rendered distinctly from an expected owner.

BOARD-BLOCKED.title: Ticket blocked by a rejected hard gate
BOARD-BLOCKED.description: Architecture review rejected this ticket. Because the governing gate is a hard gate, the board must show a Blocked status and name the responsible gate and its owner.

ARCH_APPROVED.note: Introduces a new service without a documented boundary.

BOARD-WAIT.title: Unassigned ticket awaiting its expected owner
BOARD-WAIT.description: No assignee is set on this ticket. The board should display the expected owner for the security stage, visually distinguished from a real assignee.
